review.note: T.R.-era check: act of March 4, 1907, ch. 2928 (Public No. 263), 34 Stat. 1411, approved by Theodore Roosevelt at 11 a.m. that day; it appropriated $25,000 for the War Department to complete the Chalmette monument once Louisiana ceded the site.
